channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Tarcísio e Nunes inauguram praça na região onde se concentrava fluxo da Cracolândia
item.description: São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes and Governor Tarcísio de Freitas inaugurated Praça do Triunfo in the Santa Ifigênia neighborhood, formerly known as Cracolândia, as part of a security and social assistance initiative to remove drug users from the streets. The event took place within the electoral justice window allowing Tarcísio, a reelection candidate, to attend public acts. Both officials used the occasion to criticize past harm-reduction policies, linking them to crack use, and promoted a narrative of order and drug trafficking combat.

item.title: Flávio chama Michelle de “desinformada” após fala sobre Vorcaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) accused former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro of being 'completely misinformed' after she shared a video implying his participation in parties hosted by Daniel Vorcaro, founder of Banco Master. He denied any involvement with Vorcaro-linked events, stating he never boarded his plane or attended his parties, and expressed confidence that the rift with Michelle would be overcome so she could join the party's electoral campaign.

item.title: STF tem 4 votos para anular doação de fiel à Igreja Universal
item.description: The STF has four votes to reject the Universal Church of the Kingdom of God's appeal seeking to overturn a court ruling that requires the return of donations made by a follower under claims of irresistible moral coercion. Justice Edson Fachin, joined by Cármen Lúcia, Alexandre de Moraes, and Cristiano Zanin, voted to uphold the Minas Gerais Court of Justice's decision, which holds that religious pressure on followers constitutes abuse of right and obliges restitution, including material and moral damages. The virtual plenary judgment will conclude on August 5.

item.title: PGR defende que Bolsonaro continue na prisão domiciliar
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet argued that former President Jair Bolsonaro should remain under house arrest, stating that the seizure of a firearm found with one of his security aides does not justify changing his detention regime, though the weapon should not be returned to him. The Federal District Civil Police concluded Bolsonaro committed no crime, as he held a valid registration for the firearm and faced no known restrictions on keeping it at home. The final decision on maintaining house arrest rests with Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: La esposa de Bolsonaro agrava la crisis en la ultraderecha brasileña al dejar su cargo en el partido
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, wife of former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro, resigned as president of PL Mulher, deepening the crisis within Brazil's far-right. Her move follows a viral video in which she accused Flávio Bolsonaro, the former president's son and the right's main presidential candidate for 2026, of 'stabbing' and 'humiliating' her. Flávio is seen as the primary challenger to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the upcoming election.

item.title: Flávio no 2º turno é tudo o que o Lula quer, diz Caiado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado stated that a runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro would be 'everything Lula wants', while he believes that if he reaches the runoff, he will gain independent voters' support and defeat the president. He also announced Gilberto Kassab as his running mate, emphasizing the strength of the PSD ticket and his goal to 'return Brazil to decent Brazilians'. According to an AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll, Lula leads Flávio Bolsonaro 48.8% to 42.3% in a hypothetical runoff, and leads Caiado 48% to 39%.

item.title: Praça substitui cracolândia no centro de SP
item.description: São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB) and Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) inaugurated Praça do Triunfo in the city center, built on the site formerly known as 'cracolândia' on Rua dos Protestantes in Santa Ifigênia. The area, which until a year and a half ago was one of the main concentrations of crack users in the capital, has been requalified into a public leisure and conviviality space. The initiative is part of urban revitalization and drug use combat policies in central areas.

item.title: Aliado de Flávio que disse que mulheres votam mal aceita crítica, mas insiste: 'Está errado'
item.description: Influencer Paulo Figueiredo said Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) did the right thing by publicly rejecting his claim that women vote poorly, but he maintained his position, insisting the senator is factually wrong on the issue. Figueiredo affirmed his original stance remains valid despite the criticism from his political ally.

item.title: PF abre inquérito sobre emendas enviadas a entidades ligadas ao filme ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: The Federal Police opened an investigation into whether parliamentary amendments directed to entities linked to the film 'Dark Horse', about former President Jair Bolsonaro, were diverted to finance the film's production. The inquiry was authorized by Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino last Friday.

item.title: PGR defende que Bolsonaro siga em prisão domiciliar e que arma apreendida em blitz seja retida
item.description: The Attorney General's Office (PGR) argued that former President Jair Bolsonaro should remain under house arrest, stating there is no 'serious fault' in the incident involving a firearm seized during a traffic stop involving his security aide. The PGR also recommended that the seized Glock 9mm pistol not be returned, maintaining the current penal regime. The final decision rests with Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, who is expected to rule in the coming days.

item.title: Feliciano cobra Flávio e sai em defesa de Michelle em nova crise dos Bolsonaros
item.description: Federal deputy Marco Feliciano (PL-SP) publicly pressed Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for the presidency, over his role in the ongoing Bolsonaro family crisis, questioning his commitment to former President Jair Bolsonaro’s legacy. At the same time, Feliciano defended Michelle Bolsonaro, the former first lady, emphasizing her loyalty and influence within the evangelical base of Bolsonarism. The statement deepens internal rifts within the Bolsonaro family ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: ACM Neto minimiza impacto de agendas de Lula na Bahia e diz que o petista 'pode estar sendo enrolado' por Jerônimo
item.description: ACM Neto, the União Brasil pre-candidate for governor of Bahia, downplayed the electoral impact of President Lula's recent visits to the state, stating that Lula's presence 'changes nothing' in the electoral scenario. He suggested Lula might be being 'misled' by Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues regarding the Salvador-Itaparica Bridge works and criticized the PT administration for allegedly losing control of public security in Bahia.

item.title: Câmara acelera tramitação do projeto que equipara misoginia a racismo
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved urgency for the bill equating misogyny with racism, allowing direct plenary vote without committee review. Though already passed by the Senate, the proposal faces resistance from evangelical and Catholic caucuses seeking religious exemptions. Relator Deputy Tabata Amaral (PSB-SP) will seek consensus across all blocs.

item.title: IA avança na vida digital dos brasileiros
item.description: Brazil ranks second globally in positive sentiment toward technology, with 81% of consumers trusting AI and 96% valuing personalized device protection, according to Assurant’s 2026 Global Connected Consumer Trends Report. Rapid AI adoption is driving demand for intuitive, reliable, and always-available digital experiences that balance innovation with simplicity and security. Brazil is setting a new global benchmark for user-centered digital experiences, where trust in technology is high and personalization is a key purchase driver.

item.title: Saída de Michelle do PL poderia parecer divisão e Flávio precisa de unidade urgente, diz Celina Leão
item.description: The governor of the Federal District, Celina Leão (PL), advocated for Michelle Bolsonaro to remain in the PL and as a Senate pre-candidate, stating that her departure could be seen as a split in the right and harm the unity needed to attract female voters in 2026. Celina emphasized that Michelle has built an independent political legacy and is crucial for Flávio Bolsonaro’s campaign to regain women’s support. Despite tensions between Michelle and Flávio, Celina reaffirmed her backing of the senator as the presidential pre-candidate.

item.title: Moraes determina investigação a partir de conteúdo encontrado no celular de Wassef
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes ordered a confidential and separate investigation into alleged 'fortuitous events' found on the cellphone of Frederick Wassef, lawyer for Jair and Flávio Bolsonaro, within the Saudi jewels inquiry. The decision followed a Federal Police request, giving the PGR 15 days to respond. Wassef denies wrongdoing and claims the phone search was conducted without OAB presence, violating his legal privileges.

item.title: Voto das mulheres: o que indicam as pesquisas sobre o desempenho de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Polls show Lula maintaining a comfortable lead over Flávio Bolsonaro among female voters, with margins ranging from 15 to 22 percentage points, except for the AtlasIntel poll which shows a technical tie. Among men, Flávio leads in some polls while Lula leads in others, but overall Lula holds an advantage. This dynamic explains Flávio’s concern with the female vote, given the growing share of women in the electorate and the impact of machista statements by his allies.

item.title: O que indicam as pesquisas sobre o desempenho de Crivella, liberado por Mendonça para disputar o Senado
item.description: Federal deputy Marcelo Crivella (Republicanos-RJ) had his ineligibility suspended by a TSE injunction signed by Minister André Mendonça, clearing his path to run for Senate in 2026. A Paraná Pesquisas survey from June 4 placed him second with 26% voting intention, behind Benedita da Silva (PT) at 34,2%. Crivella faces allegations of leading a criminal organization involved in the so-called 'Propina HQ' scheme, which allegedly solicited bribes from businesses in exchange for preferential treatment in municipal contracts.

item.title: A articulação de deputados do PT para tipificar o crime de traição à pátria
item.description: PT deputies introduced a bill to criminalize treason against the homeland, with penalties of 8 to 20 years, in response to Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro’s engagements with the U.S. government. The proposal targets acts benefiting foreign states or hostile organizations, such as sharing strategic information or enabling foreign interference, with enhanced penalties during elections or wartime.

item.title: Na Bahia, Lula enfileira ministros ao lado de Wagner e exalta trajetória do aliado
item.description: President Lula (PT) attended public events in Alagoinhas and Salvador alongside Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA), praising Wagner’s political trajectory and reaffirming their alliance despite speculation from a Federal Police operation at Wagner’s residence. Lula avoided referencing the 'Master' scandal, emphasizing friendship and historical partnership, while also mentioning Rui Costa and Otto Alencar as key Bahia allies. He will not attend the traditional July 2nd procession in Salvador, citing scheduling conflicts related to an event in Juazeiro on the São Francisco River transposition project.

item.title: "Não vamos deixar a esquerda voltar a governar SP", esbraveja Nunes
item.description: São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB) declared that the left will not be allowed to govern the city again, speaking alongside Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) at the inauguration of Praça do Triunfo, a site formerly associated with Cracolândia. Nunes denounced former Mayor Fernando Haddad’s (PT) 'Braços Abertos' social program as a 'crack basket' and reiterated commitments to security and social services for drug users.

item.title: Câmara aprova urgência do PL da misoginia; veja como votaram deputados e partidos
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved the urgency of the 'misogyny bill,' which seeks to criminalize incitement of violence against women with penalties of 2 to 5 years in prison, akin to racial insult laws. The measure passed with 293 votes in favor and 158 against, allowing it to bypass committee review and proceed directly to plenary floor debate. Reporter Tabata Amaral (PSB-SP) will lead the bill’s development, with a vote expected before the July 18 legislative recess.

item.title: PL faz nova representação contra governo Lula por propagandas
item.description: The PL filed a new representation with the TSE against the Lula government, alleging excessive spending on institutional advertising in the first half of 2026, citing a Folha de S.Paulo report stating the government authorized R$520 million for institutional communication, which the party claims violates the legal spending cap in an election year. The party requests an immediate suspension of advertising campaigns and a ban on new expenditures until the government proves compliance with electoral law.

item.title: Após reveses contra o STF, senador pró-anistia vê ‘desmoralização’ da Justiça brasileira no exterior
item.description: Senator Esperidião Amin (PP-SC) criticized STF rulings on the January 8 attacks and claimed that extradition refusals by countries like Spain, the U.S., Italy, and Argentina are undermining the credibility of Brazil's judiciary abroad. He argued these decisions reveal legal weakness in the convictions and advocated for an amnesty bill for those involved. Despite political stalemate on amnesty, Congress passed a bill to recalculate sentences for the convicted.

item.title: Saída de Michelle do PL Mulher domina as redes, mas não repete impacto de vídeo contra Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro's departure from the presidency of PL Mulher dominated social media discussions, but did not match the impact of her previous videos criticizing her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro. The episode highlights ongoing divisions within the Bolsonarist movement, though it lacked the viral reach of earlier controversies.

item.title: O número que chama atenção sobre Renan Santos em reduto de Caiado
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential pre-candidate from the Missão party, obtained 13.3% voting intentions in the Central-West region, surpassing former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado, who scored 6%. The result is notable as it occurred in Caiado’s political stronghold, signaling growth in Renan’s pre-campaign among right-wing voters seeking an alternative to the establishment.

item.title: TCU veta indicação de dirigentes partidários a estatais de serviços
item.description: The TCU ruled that members of party decision-making bodies, even if unpaid, cannot be appointed to leadership positions in federal public service state-owned enterprises if they served in such roles within the last 36 months. The decision affirms that the State-Owned Enterprises Law already prohibited such appointments, now clarified to apply to entities like the Rio de Janeiro Ports Company, and is grounded in the STF’s view that these restrictions serve governance, not political punishment.

item.title: Câmara avança com projeto que criminaliza misoginia e aprova votação com urgência
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved the urgency regime for the bill criminalizing misogyny, with 293 votes in favor and 158 against, following negotiations led by Deputy Tabata Amaral (PSB-SP) and party leaders. The approval allows the bill to be voted on directly in plenary, bypassing permanent committees, with merit analysis expected within the next two weeks before the recess. The main point of contention involves demands from the Christian bloc to include protection for religious freedom, arguing that religious expressions should not be classified as misogyny under the proposed law.

item.title: Celina Leão nega divisão entre Michelle e Flávio
item.description: The governor of the Federal District, Celina Leão, denied any rift between Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro, stating that Michelle’s resignation from the presidency of PL Mulher was agreed upon with her husband, former president Jair Bolsonaro. Celina added that Michelle needs time for personal care and is only stepping down temporarily, while remaining affiliated with the party.

item.title: Câmara aprova urgência para projeto de combate à misoginia
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved urgency for a bill combating misogyny, amending the Anti-Racism Law to include acts of discrimination against women. The proposal establishes a penalty of 2 to 5 years in prison for insult 'based on gender,' with an increase of half if committed by two or more people. The vote sparked protests from the evangelical bloc, fearing restrictions on religious freedom, while rapporteur Tabata Amaral said she remains open to dialogue.

item.title: Liminar de André Mendonça libera Marcelo Crivella para disputar Senado pelo RJ
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça granted a temporary injunction lifting Marcelo Crivella's ineligibility, allowing him to run for Senate in RJ in 2026. The ruling preserves the special appeal while preventing irreparable harm before final judgment. Crivella's original TRE-RJ conviction stems from the 'QG da Propina' scheme, where municipal funds were steered to favored companies in exchange for illegal campaign financing in his 2016 and 2020 mayoral bids.

item.title: Urnas vão julgar políticos do caso Master antes de STF bater o martelo sobre condenações
item.description: The 2026 elections will judge politicians involved in the Banco Master scandal before the STF concludes the judicial process, which is likely to extend into 2027. Although the PF may finish its investigation before October, the PGR is expected to delay filing charges due to the electoral period, reducing judicial pressure on candidates. Figures like Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula are expected to suffer greater electoral damage than legal penalties, as the scandal loses momentum after elections amid declining public outrage.

item.title: Lula mostra curativo na cabeça após retirada de câncer de pele; veja vídeo
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva revealed a head bandage following a procedure to remove skin cancer, specifically a low-aggressiveness basal cell carcinoma detected in April. He completed 15 sessions of preventive radiotherapy at the Sírio-Libanês Hospital in June, after surgical removal in São Paulo. Lula showed the bandage at an event in Bahia and affirmed he is well, having worn a hat in public appearances since the treatment.

item.title: União Brasil confirma pré-candidatura de Rueda a deputado federal pelo RJ
item.description: União Brasil confirmed that Antonio de Rueda, the party's national president and president of the União Progressista federation (União Brasil + PP), is a pre-candidate for federal deputy from Rio de Janeiro in the 2026 elections. A native of Pernambuco, Rueda has never held elected office and is set to begin his political career with this candidacy.

item.title: Após deixar o PL Mulher, Michelle Bolsonaro exibe apoio de lideranças de 10 estados
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro stepped down from leading PL Mulher and responded by republishing 12 posts from allies across 10 states on her Instagram, expressing gratitude and support amid her conflict with Flávio Bolsonaro. The move follows her public clarification note about leaving the party. The content is subscriber-only.

item.title: Justiça anula segunda extradição e Zambelli terá novo julgamento na Itália
item.description: Italy's Supreme Court annulled the second extradition authorization for former deputy Carla Zambelli, ordering a new review by the Rome Court of Appeal. The defense argued she did not receive a fair trial, citing insufficient time to review documents submitted by Brazilian authorities. The case stems from her STF conviction for illegal firearm possession and illegal constriction against journalist Luan Araújo.

item.title: Governador da Bahia concede maior honraria do Estado a Dilma Rousseff
item.description: Bahia Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) awarded former President Dilma Rousseff the Ordem 2 de Julho – Libertadores da Bahia, the state's highest honor, in the rank of Comendadora. The appointment was published in the Bahia Official Gazette on June 30, 2026, recognizing her defense of liberty, democracy, and the rights of the Bahian people. Eighteen other individuals and institutions were also honored, including cultural figures and PT politicians, though the specific degrees awarded were not disclosed.

item.title: PT critica congressistas por “transformar igrejas em palanques”
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) released a letter addressed to Catholics, criticizing lawmakers for 'turning churches into pulpits' and advocating for social, labor, and environmental policies. The document endorses President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election bid in 2026 and reaffirms the party's commitment to a secular state, religious freedom, and respect for diverse beliefs, while avoiding sensitive topics such as abortion.

item.title: CRIMINOSA! Veja como a pesquisa de hoje com LULA na frente deveria ser investigada
item.description: The content claims that a recent poll showing Lula leading in voting intentions is 'criminal' and should be investigated, reflecting distrust in the legitimacy of polling data. No specific candidates beyond Lula are mentioned, and no public policies are discussed. The tone is critical and polarized, indicating negative sentiment toward the poll and possibly toward Lula himself.

item.title: Após reprimenda de Flávio Bolsonaro, Paulo Figueiredo reage: 'Meu apoio permanece'
item.description: Paulo Figueiredo reaffirmed his support for Flávio Bolsonaro after the senator publicly rebuked him for stating that 'women vote very poorly'. Figueiredo said he respects Flávio’s criticism but will maintain his enthusiastic support, emphasizing that his opinions are personal and not representative of the campaign. The exchange occurs amid Flávio’s efforts to improve his image among female voters, following controversies involving Michelle Bolsonaro.

item.title: PT propõe crime de traição após ofensiva bolsonarista nos EUA
item.description: PT deputies have proposed a bill creating the crime of treason against the homeland, punishable by 8 to 20 years in prison, motivated by the Bolsonaro family's actions in the United States. The proposal aims to impose sanctions on Brazilian authorities. The bill targets acts benefiting foreign states, hostile international organizations, or their agents, including sharing strategic information or facilitating foreign interference.

item.title: Pivô da crise, Priscila Costa posta mensagem de gratidão a Michelle, mas vai a evento de Flávio Bolsonaro com mulheres
item.description: Priscila Costa, a key ally of Michelle Bolsonaro, attended an event hosted by Flávio Bolsonaro for PL women on the same day she posted a message of gratitude to Michelle. Her appearance was interpreted as a gesture of easing tensions within the Bolsonarist movement, especially after Michelle stepped down from leading PL Mulher. While Michelle supports Costa’s Senate bid in Ceará, Flávio’s faction favors state deputy Alcides Fernandes for the seat.

item.title: Caixa Econômica Federal bate marca de 1 trilhão de reais em crédito imobiliário
item.description: Caixa Econômica Federal reached R$1 trillion in housing credit in June, a 14% increase from the same month last year, solidifying its leadership with 68% market share. The growth is largely driven by the Minha Casa, Minha Vida program, which accounts for 58% of its housing credit portfolio and for which Caixa holds nearly all contracts. The bank is also expanding into middle-income housing through SBPE, FGTS, and LCIs.

item.title: Damares revela ameaças após ataques nas redes: ‘Disseram que vão matar minha filha’
item.description: Senator Damares Alves disclosed she received death threats against her indigenous daughter, including simulated images of decapitation and impalement, amid a wave of social media attacks she described as gender-based political violence. She stated these attacks transcend political criticism and aim to intimidate women in public life, urging others not to retreat despite fear. The Senate’s female caucus plans to discuss institutional measures to combat such violence, even without formal complaints from victims.

item.title: Tarcísio muda de ideia sobre privatizar Linha 17-Ouro do Monotrilho
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas stated he has changed his mind about privatizing the 17-Gold Monorail Line, saying it is no longer necessary to transfer operations to the private sector. He emphasized the risk of concentrating metropolitan train lines under few private operators and suggested the metro should continue operating these lines, focusing on expansion. ViaMobilidade, the current concessionaire, confirmed there are no formal discussions underway regarding operational changes.

item.title: O que está por trás da escolha de Gilberto Kassab como vice de Caiado
item.description: Gilberto Kassab was nominated as vice on Ronaldo Caiado's ticket to strengthen the PSD's political articulation, particularly in stitching together state-level slates, with a focus on the Northeast, although his nomination is seen as politically motivated rather than electorally driven, as he is not viewed as a vote-getter. His presence increases pressure on party members hesitant to support Caiado, as not joining the ticket is now seen as rejecting the party president himself. Despite this, Kassab states the party will respect local circumstances and keeps open the possibility of alliances with other parties.

item.title: Blogueiro diz que Flávio Bolsonaro foi ‘vitimista’ e volta a atacar Michelle
item.description: Blogger Paulo Figueiredo, advisor to Flávio Bolsonaro, labeled the pre-candidate as 'victim-minded' for feeling offended by his remarks that 'women vote terribly'. Figueiredo also renewed attacks on Michelle Bolsonaro, calling her a 'plague', and claimed to be 'much further to the right' than Flávio, despite the latter publicly repudiating his comments at a conservative women's event.

item.title: “Desinformada”, diz Flávio após Michelle repostar vídeo sobre festas de Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro for sharing a video by former Rio de Janeiro governor Anthony Garotinho, who claims to have attended parties organized by former banker Daniel Vorcaro with the presence of politicians. Flávio said Michelle is 'completely uninformed' for reposting the content, implying she lacks understanding of its context or implications. The remark came amid growing family and political tensions within the Bolsonaro clan, especially as Flávio positions himself as a pre-candidate for president in 2026.

item.title: Mendonça pede que PGR opine sobre investigação do caso Dark Horse
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça received a request from federal deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT) to investigate whether funding for the film 'Dark Horse' by Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master was used to finance Eduardo Bolsonaro’s political activities in the U.S. The case was initially reviewed by Justice Alexandre de Moraes but reassigned by STF President Edson Fachin after the PGR stated an investigation was already underway under Mendonça’s rapporteurship. Eduardo Bolsonaro signed as executive producer of the film in January 2024, per a document from Intercept Brasil.

item.title: Damares diz que candidatura de Michelle é "importante para o Brasil"
item.description: Senator Damares Alves (Republicanos-DF) stated that the potential Senate candidacy of Michelle Bolsonaro in the Federal District for the 2026 elections is "important for Brazil," reinforcing support for the ex-first lady within the PL party. Damares, alongside Governor Celina Leão (PP), persuaded Michelle not to leave the PL, which would have jeopardized her Senate bid. The meeting took place at the Buriti Palace on June 30, after which Michelle announced her resignation from national leadership of PL Mulher.
